assign.request: UX reviewer, second pass: rethink /imagine/stream/ landing page per reviewer-brief.md - five sentences, try an alternative layout for real and measure it, make it more visual, check persistence, ui-test, land.
steps: build 3-column card alternative on landing page
make it more visual (real stills on child previews)

log.msg: FIVE SENTENCES (before). what: a page that claims editing one browser tab updates another instantly, with no reload. use: read the claim, then click into one of three demo cards (wire, deck, blocks) to actually try it in two tabs. goal: leave believing the append-only-log mechanism works and knowing where to see it proved. hard: 2/5 - the writing is clear and the mechanism is well explained, but the ONE thing being claimed (two tabs, live) never appears on the page you land on; you have to click through and open a second tab yourself before you see anything move. better: put the live proof on the landing page itself - two synced mini panes with a real measured-live latency number beside them, so the claim is shown, not just quoted, before the first click.

ALTERNATIVE TRIED: the owner's 3-column card on the landing page itself. Left: title+intro. Centre: TWO independently-subscribed Stream("wire") instances (two real sockets on data/wire.jsonl, not one instance shown twice) rendered as "window A" (editable input) and "window B" (a mirror) - typing in A is visible in B on THIS page, no second tab required to see the claim proven. Right: live medians (per-instance) and the log's own byte count. KEPT. Measured .page-column-body scrollHeight (its own rect is overflow-y:auto and clipped, never grows; document scrollHeight is pinned to viewport by the columns shell - both known traps). 1280: 1358px -> 1326px. 3440: 1651px -> 1620px. Page got ~2% SHORTER at both widths, not taller, because the two mechanism sections below the card (append RPC, Durable Objects - real depth) were folded into a second <details> to pay down the card's own ~450px cost. Width used and dead space unchanged (46.0% / 1856px dead at 3440) - the known site-wide column cap, not this page's finding.

PATH BUG CAUGHT AND FIXED: my own before-1280 console check surfaced a pre-existing 404 - /imagine/decks/thumbs/deck.jpg. stream/deck/page.js still declared a dead `shapes:` field left over from decks/deck.js's own 2026-09-05 refactor (diagram()+shapes: reader removed in favour of a real screenshot preview, per that file's own header note) - this deck was the only page in the repo still declaring it. Separately Deck.preview()'s thumb path (base+thumbs/+this.name+.jpg) hardcodes decks/deck.js's OWN directory as `base`, which 404s for any deck living outside /imagine/decks/. Fixed locally: stream/deck/page.js overrides preview() with this.url+shot.jpg (this.url is already correct per-page from Page.class.js) and dropped the dead shapes: field. PROPOSED for decks/deck.js (not edited, outside this realm) in doc/decisions.md: swap `base` for `this.url` in that one line so every deck, in any realm, finds its own thumb.

VISUAL: wire/, blocks/, deck/ children previews swapped from icon+description to real still screenshots (shot.jpg beside each page.js) - matches the night's most-repeated win. Dropping the thumb also drops nav.description per Page.preview_card, so no extra height cost.

assign.now: ui-test run; console checked; writing readme + report

log.msg: UI-TEST: the primary gesture, for real - two SEPARATE Playwright browser contexts (true tab isolation, not two pages sharing one context) both on http://localhost:8110/imagine/stream/. Typed a timestamped stamp into tab A's hero window-A input; polled tab B's window-B mirror (a hidden/background tab gets no rAF, per the layout skill, so polling not a timer-wait). PASS - tab B showed the exact stamp. Real measured latency this run: window A redrew in 2ms, window B redrew in 3ms (both under the page's own claimed 9ms). Zero console/page errors in either tab. Also checked landing page at 1280 and 3440 separately: zero console errors both widths, both before and after my changes except the deck thumb 404 (see prior log), which is now fixed.

PERSISTENCE: none via the audited mechanism - grep -rn store()|localStorage public/imagine/stream/ returns nothing. The realm DOES persist state, but through the mechanism that IS the whole demo: shared server-side data/*.json + data/*.jsonl files, edited by whoever opens the page, with the page's own Compact/Clear the log buttons as its built-in, always-visible way back (Compact folds+keeps the current state; Clear throws the log away and reverts to the snapshot) - a different, already-visible version of the same baseline/modified/reset contract paging/doc/persistence.md asks for, so no baseline.js mark was added on top of it.

FIVE SENTENCES (after). what: a page with a live card showing two independent, separately-connected windows editing the same file side by side. use: type in the left window of the card at the top of the page; the right window updates on its own, with a live latency number beside it. goal: leave having WATCHED the claim happen on the page you landed on, not just read it, and know where three fuller demos are if you want to try it in a real second tab. hard: 2/5 - obvious that typing on the left changes the right, because it is shown rather than described; the one thing that still needs the caption is that these are two SEPARATE listeners (not one box mirrored by script), which is the whole point of the page. better: a one-click 'pop out window B' button that opens it in a literal second real tab would remove the last shred of doubt that this is script-mirrored rather than genuinely two sockets - the honest next step, not built tonight.

assign.outcome: **Kept the owner's 3-column card on the landing page** — the centre is now two independently-subscribed `Stream("wire")` windows (real, separate sockets on `data/wire.jsonl`), not a static "9 ms" claim; typing in the left window is visible in the right one, proved across two REAL browser tabs (ui-test, not just same-page) at 2–3ms measured. The page got **~2% shorter** at both 1280 and 3440 (1358→1326px, 1651→1620px), not taller — the two mechanism sections below the card were folded into a second disclosure to pay down the card's own height. All three child cards (wire/deck/blocks) swapped from icon+text to real still thumbnails. Found and fixed a pre-existing console 404 on the deck card (a stale `shapes:` field plus a per-realm thumb-path bug in the shared `Deck` class) — fixed locally, one-line fix proposed for `decks/deck.js` in `doc/decisions.md` (not applied, outside this realm). Zero console errors at 1280/3440 across all four touched pages, before and after.
